lines.en: So how is this for a big double date tonight?
Right, just the reaction I was hoping for.
Ah, yeah, so you, uh, you found someone for me?
Of course not, and you are gonna love Mary Ellen.
She's really smart and cute and funny, and...
I can't tell you how I know this,
but she is not opposed to threesomes.
So tell me something about my guy.
Damn it, is there no mystery left in romance anymore?
All right, we'll see you and Mike at the restaurant in a couple hours.
Why'd I have to say Mike?
